limits: Official EIP-6963-only connection remains unsuccessful in the tested unmodified page.
Panel implemented in isolated experiment only; no Aerodrome deployment changed.
Provider references, labels and numbers do not authenticate publishers. Different wrapper objects are not automatically merged.
List cleanup does not revoke permissions or uninstall extensions; rediscovery may recreate a duplicate.
Real extensions, pending permission prompts, mobile, WalletConnect, arbitrary malicious providers, signed login and full accessibility/independent security audits are unverified.
Earlier Phase 14 Chrome timeout remains unexplained.
evidenceNotes: Compact recovery/lifecycle snapshots retain visible choices, mock RPC histories and empty/granted accounts. Public-page prose, discovery traces and PNG bytes are omitted here; full raw observations including panel PNGs are in workflow artifacts. Twelve green diagnostics include expected official failure and ambiguity refusal.
